title: epipactis longifolia var. gibbosa
intro: Epipactis longifolia var. gibbosa, commonly known as the Helleborine, is a species of orchid native to Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in relieving respiratory issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis longifolia var. gibbosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential uses of this plant, and its use should be approached with caution and under the guidance of a medical professional.
